name: later-filter-type-head-first
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.name = 'field' OR n.name = 'RED' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: reverse-filter-same-type-head
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.name = 'RED' OR n.name = 'field' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: field-error-without-enum-stream
query: MATCH (n:FieldNode) WHERE n.name = 'field' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: bad-enum-unmatched-not-decoded
query: MATCH (n:EnumConstant) WHERE n.name = 'missing' RETURN DISTINCT n.id AS x LIMIT 1
